title: 日本ダービーの後に・あなたの夢の次は

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky loses the Japanese Derby, the second race of the Classic Triple Crown, to Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd roars with excitement. Special Week will only grow more popular now that she's proven how strong she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her strength leaves an impression on Seiun Sky, and we continue on our path to the Kikuka Sho, the final Classic Triple Crown race.
